easyPrerequisites: You control six or more lands.
description:
Cast Clone by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Anticausal Vestige.
When Clone enters, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Anticausal Vestige from the battlefield to your hand.
When Anticausal Vestige leaves the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to draw a card and and put Anticausal Vestige from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Anticausal Vestige enters, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Clone from the battlefield to your hand.
When Clone leaves the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Clone from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Anticausal Vestige.
Repeat from step 2.
